title: Projects
text:
Currently, I am working on a simulation study about fairness in clinical prediction models. I am writing my master’s thesis at the Department of Biostatistics and Data Science at the University Medical Center Utrecht, under the supervision of Anne De Hond and Maarten Van Smeden.





I am doing an research internship at the Methodology, Statistics and Data Science Department at Utrecht University where I work together with Alfons Edmar and Irene Klugkist on Effect Size Harmonization in Bayesian Evidence Synthesis.

title: Projects
